liaisons.fullName: American Association of Veterinary State Boards
liaisons.keyContacts: Amy Farmer, Octavio Jones, Channing Benson, Jim Penrod
liaisons.currentFocus: AAVSB bylaw amendment and protecting dedicated stakeholder seats on the VTNE committee.
liaisons.lastUpdate: June 22 meeting centered on the proposed AAVSB bylaw amendment. AVTE's liaison raised the concern that the change lacks written policy guaranteeing dedicated stakeholder seats on the VTNE committee; board liaison Robin agreed to take it back to the AAVSB board and understood the desire for written policy before the vote. Awaiting AAVSB's statement.

liaisons.currentFocus: VTNE/CVTEA crosswalk and defining entry-level competency.
liaisons.lastUpdate: 6/14 follow-up on unfinished CVTEA business (standards and skills changes; public report out shortly) and 6/11 crosswalk work session. Strong discussion on Canada vs. US program scores, VTNE domains that do not align with skills (much of it wording to fix on both sides), and the need to define entry level. AVTE should develop a position on what counts as entry level.

liaisons.currentFocus: CrVT promotion campaign and articles for JAVTE.
liaisons.lastUpdate: CAVT had a PR campaign for National Vet Tech Week. Several CrVTs authored articles for JAVTE.

liaisons.fullName: Association of American Veterinary Medical Colleges

liaisons.lastUpdate: July 10 meeting at the AVMA convention. No formal agenda, but AAVMC's leadership program was discussed and aligns with AVTE's proposed outline; AVTE has requested their outcome data to review. AAVMC went into closed session on the future of accreditation.
